referencePhotos.silhouetteNotes: Near-orthographic independent official body photo. Camera registered by documented body width; source CAD unchanged; measurement and scope mismatches remain failures.

textures.notes: Only actual printed film/paper ROI; shell, fasteners, holes and display excluded. Original photograph pixels retained; no generated or recolored content.
textures.method: Fixed axis-aligned crop; original-coordinate explicit alpha ROI at4x supersampling when alphaMask supplied; exclusions remove fasteners/holes/shell. No generated pixels or perspective warp.

front.basis: Independent official photograph width and documented body width set camera scale/center only; no geometry scaling. Scope differences and manufacturer-dimension discrepancies remain failures.

back.basis: Independent official photograph width and documented body width set camera scale/center only; no geometry scaling. Scope differences and manufacturer-dimension discrepancies remain failures.

USB-Grove-side.basis: Qualitative camera orientation chosen from official photograph; perspective/crop not metrically calibrated.

SD-side.basis: Qualitative camera orientation chosen from official photograph; perspective/crop not metrically calibrated.

tessellation.step: OpenCascade 7.8.1.1; absolute deflection0.05mm, angle0.2rad, native solids plus orphan shells/faces; units converted by STEP reader to millimetres

provenance.photoRights: Official product photographs copyright M5Stack / named manufacturer. No separate open photo license verified; retained for product reference, not relicensed under project MIT.

sources.title: CoreS3-SE
sources.notes: Reused actual corpus receipt 2026-10-26T15:19:22.786119Z; no new fetch timestamp invented.

limitations: Source lower cover reaches overall 16.5 mm depth; table states 15.5 mm. No stretching or cover removal was used to force a pass.
No camera, IMU or battery capacity has been copied from sibling CoreS3 configurations.
Runtime board/peripherals are not implemented for this SKU; geometry preview does not establish firmware compatibility.
Photo and geometry comparisons remain partial; no complete 1:1 manufacturing or populated-PCB certification.
Source CAD MIT and manufacturer photographs have distinct rights; no separate open photo license verified.
Blank display rectangle uses documented active dimensions when available; placement/window boundary is estimated from photos/CAD, not a calibrated measurement.
本轮继续按真实厂家照片审核；刻字、部分贴纸、端子及内部PCB未全部还原，不能视为整机1:1通过。
Rear M-BUS open housing, four silver fastener heads and rubber feet are photo-derived external details; dimensions/depth are estimates, not manufacturer connector CAD.
